events.title: Ballmer: "Developers!" chant
events.summary: At [Microsoft]'s 25th anniversary event, CEO Steve Ballmer screams the word developers on stage — sweat, volume, and pure hype.
events.about: The clip became one of tech's earliest viral videos — parodied, remixed, and cited whenever a platform needs third-party apps. Ballmer later reprised it as 'web developers' in 2008.

narrative.whyChosen: Peak CEO energy — a meme before memes had a name.
narrative.whyImportant: It symbolized [Microsoft]'s platform bet on ISVs and the Windows ecosystem.
narrative.problemSolved: [Microsoft] needed to rally partners around building on its stack.
